# OpenThesis 1.0.0-alpha.2

## 中文

本架构预览版提供真正的 Windows 便携 ZIP。完整解压后直接运行
`OpenThesis\OpenThesis.exe`，无需安装，也不会弹出命令行窗口。

新工作台已经接入真实 SEC 公司研究、常用模型与在线模型目录、会话级 API Key、
双模型对比、研究模块、反向 DCF、多 Agent 研究流程和追加式投资逻辑版本管理。

API Key、个人 SEC 联系邮箱和研究历史不会被打包进发行文件。

同时新增模型连接测试、`.othesis` 模块导入、异常中断研究恢复，以及报告缩放、
专注阅读和按需技术详情。

原生报告导出、模型帮助链接和架构诊断现已通过跨平台 Tauri 适配层实现。

## English

This architecture preview ships as a true Windows portable ZIP. Extract the
archive completely and run `OpenThesis\OpenThesis.exe`; no installation or
console window is required.

The new workbench now includes real SEC company research, built-in and online
model catalogs, session-only API keys, two-model comparison, research packs,
reverse DCF, the full multi-agent workflow, and append-only thesis versioning.
It also adds model connection testing, `.othesis` pack import, interrupted-run
recovery, report zoom, focus reading, and opt-in technical details.
Native report export, provider help links, and architecture diagnostics are now
implemented through the cross-platform Tauri adapter.

API keys, personal SEC contact details, and research history are not included
in the release archive.
